summary: v149 Edit Note modal horizontal-containment verified. Reproduced the user-reported real-time keystroke scenario at phone width (400x900) and confirmed the modal DOES NOT grow horizontally as the user types long category names inside the category-path pop-out. Per-keystroke sampling across all 63 chars of 'Sub category testing hierarchy words that are quite long here': modal.width was 368px on every single sample (delta=0px), scrollWidth===clientWidth (400===400) at every sample, window.scrollX stayed 0. Pin-label span is correctly truncated (overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, white-space:nowrap) even with 149-char text (scrollWidth=832 vs offsetWidth=254). Pin toggle right-edge stays fixed at x=359 whether L1 is 5-char or 55-char. L2/L3/L4 all long: modal still 368px, no page overflow. Desktop 1440x900 modal stays hard-locked at 512px (max-w-lg) throughout typing. Cache is iron-rabbit-v149.
